title: A split morphism has the complementary structure maps as kernel and cokernel
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a pair of morphisms j : y -> x and q : x -> y with q j the identity, the endomorphism id minus j q has j as kernel and q as cokernel (statement lines 666-677). The proof is a complete argument for the kernel statement: the composite with j vanishes, existence in the universal property follows from the displayed computation a = j q a, and uniqueness from the computation b = q j b = q a (proof lines 680-690); the cokernel statement follows by duality (proof lines 692-693). The non-formal content is the verification of the two halves of the universal property. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
